segments.name: Semiconductor foundry
segments.description: Global semiconductor foundry manufacturing differentiated chips for automotive, communications infrastructure and data center, smart mobile devices, and home and industrial IoT customers.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that the Company has a single reportable segment and operating segment structure.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor designers pay GF for wafer manufacturing and related services, bought primarily through a direct sales organization and technical account managers.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily sell our manufacturing services through a direct sales organization supported by technical account managers and customer application engineers, who work closely with customers to understand and meet their design and production requirements.
